findings.body: [high] `logStreamError` changed signature from `(logger, err, res)` to `(err, reply, res)`. Any caller still passing a logger as the first argument will now hand a pino instance to `streamError` as `err`. Callers in `lib/route.js` and `lib/four-oh-four.js` must be updated in the same PR.

[medium] `opts.disableRequestLogging || defaultInitOptions.disableRequestLogging` treats an explicit `false` the same as `undefined`. If the default ever becomes truthy, users cannot opt out. Prefer `??`.

[low] `instanceof LogController` rejects duck-typed controllers and any controller built from a second copy of fastify in `node_modules` (monorepos, peer-dep mismatches). Consider a structural check on the required methods instead.

summary.body:
Introduces a `LogController` extension point and routes all internal request-lifecycle logging through it. The refactor is mechanically consistent, but the `logStreamError` signature change is a silent breaking change for any internal caller not updated here.

## Downstream impact
- `lib/route.js` — calls `logStreamError` for request-stream errors
- `lib/four-oh-four.js` — shares the 404 logging path now behind the controller
- `lib/reply.js` — response completion and stream error logging
